topic: Preparing data and report for client
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on preparing data and reports for a client (Gabrielle). Initial analysis provided details for two sensors at specific locations, noting that the traffic data remained consistent despite model updates. The team determined that the final submission should include both an AFA report detailing category differences and a raw data dump to allow the client to run their own models.

The required data extract needs to cover two sensors, spanning the date range of February 15th–21st, comparing results from current and new models. This data must be provided via export to an S3 bucket.

It was decided that one participant would send a follow-up email confirming the data availability while another would answer questions regarding categories and attach the AFA report.
decisions: The submission will include the AFA report detailing category differences.
A raw data dump is required for the client to run their own models.
The data extract must cover two sensors, from February 15th–21st, comparing current and new model results.
The data must be provided via export to an S3 bucket.
action_items: One participant will write to Alexey to prepare the data extract (two sensors, Feb 15-21, two models, S3 format).
A participant will send a follow-up email confirming the data is coming.
A participant will answer questions about categories and attach the AFA report.
